title: Apartment 24, Burleigh Court, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4

seller.name: Locations Office (PSR Licence no. 004194)
seller.address: Regus House,28, Pembroke Street Upper, Dublin, D02 NT28

description:
Locations.ie presents this 2nd floor two bedroom apartment in Burleigh Court just off Burlington Road in a very desirable part of Dublin 4.

The accommodation is extremely spacious comprising of the large entrance hallway, large living/dining room with access to large balcony. The kitchen is fitted with high gloss units, walnut worktops and a breakfast bar with top-of-the-range stainless steel appliances including dishwasher, washer/dryer, fridge freezer, oven, hob and microwave. The two bedrooms are well proportioned doubles with excellent wardrobe storage. The master suite is has the fully tiled en-suite bathroom. There is a second main bathroom which is also fully tiled and both bathrooms have The apartment only comes with one parking space.

The apartment benefits with good transport to make it easy to get into the city and surrounding areas, Herbert Park is nearby and excellent for walking and getting outdoors. Walking distance to St Stephens Green is about 15-20 mins and very convenient near Baggot Street, Leeson Street, Donnybrook Village and Ballsbridge. All within easy walking distance to cafes, restaurants, pubs and shops.
